title: Mobile Mass Notification System for ASG-Jordan
description: SOURCES SOUGHT SYNOPSIS Title: Mobile Mass Notification System for ASG-Jordan Directorate of Logistics Notice Type: Sources Sought Notice Number: ASG-J08262026AG. NAICS Code: 334290 � Other Communications Equipment Manufacturing or 561621 � Security Systems Services Response Due Date: 15 SEP 2026 NLT 1700 1.0 Introduction This is a Sources Sought Notice only. It is issued solely for information and planning purposes � it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This request for information does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Further, the Government is not at this time seeking proposals and will not accept unsolicited proposals. Offerors are advised that the U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this Sources Sought. 2.0 Background and Scope Area Support Group - Jordan requires a mobile mass notification capability for deployment. The purpose of this procurement is to acquire two (2) Mobile High-Powered Speaker Stations (MHPSS) and associated communication and control equipment. These systems will provide essential mobile mass notification capabilities for the base to ensure personnel safety and effective incident response. Scope of Work: The Contractor shall provide support to the ASG-J Jordan Directorate of Logistics by furnishing the following capabilities: Mobile High-Powered Speaker Stations (MHPSS) Trailer Units - Quantity: 2 Mobile Central Control Unit (MCCU) - Quantity: 1 200W Solar Power Packages - Quantity: 2 Conventional Radios (VHF/UHF Analog) & Cellular 4G LTE-A Routers - Quantity: 3 each Associated batteries, antennas, cables, and installation/start-up services. The Contractor shall perform in accordance with the standards and acceptable quality levels identified in the Performance Work Statement (PWS), applicable U.S. Army regulations, pamphlets, doctrine, Department of Defense manuals and instructions, and all other related contract documents. 3.0 Requested Information (Capability Statement) Communication Control (1 System): Mobile Central Control Unit (MCCU): Must feature a 7" touch screen for the user interface, an 8-watt amplifier with 1W internal speaker, connection for external speaker, (2) supervised push-button inputs, (1) 12VDC strobe output (1A max), (2) signaling relay outputs, microphone input, RJ45 Ethernet port, and line-level audio I/O. Control/Power: Internal 12V UPS, noise-canceling microphone, and capabilities for 8 hours of standby operation. Intelligent Control Gateway Board (ICG): Controller with a 32-bit ARM processor and multiple interfaces (Ethernet, USB, CANbus, RS232, RS485, radio, and telephone). Must support Ethernet/IP interface (including IPv6), advanced security, relays, and provide digital storage for prerecorded voice messages in field units. Outdoor High-Powered Speaker Stations (2 Systems): Audio Power: Each station must provide a minimum of 1600 watts of audio power. Enclosure: NEMA4X stainless steel siren enclosure with an attached ventilated battery compartment, integrated Class D amplifier, controller, intrusion switch, temperature-compensated battery charger, and power ON/OFF circuit breaker. Speaker Head: Stationary speaker head including four (4) 400W speaker horns with drivers. Siren Trailer: Must include a telescopic speaker pole, standard type bolt-on drawbar eye for vehicle transportation, front and rear expanding leveling jacks, utility cabinet, and rear/side vehicle lights. Local Operating Console (LOC): Must allow mounting up to 200 feet away from the panel. Must feature an LCD screen, noise-canceling microphone, and IP65 push-button membrane for local control, diagnostics, and live voice announcements. Power Supply: 200W Solar Package (including 200W solar panels, cables, and high-wind support brackets) and 12V, 100AH GEL batteries (4 per unit, 12 total required per air freight regulations). Prerecorded Messages: Must include digital message recording capabilities for at least 15 minutes of recording time, stored locally on the ICG boards. Radio and Cellular Communication Equipment: Radios: Conventional VHF/UHF Analog radios, up to 25W. Antennas & Accessories: OMNI Fiber Glass VHF antennas, surge protectors, and properly rated antenna cables. Cellular: 4G LTE-A Routers (NA compatible) with DIN rail mounting brackets and 3-in-1 Panel Antennas (2x5G/LTE, GNSS). 4.0 Submission Instructions Format: Submissions must be in [PDF/Word] format. Page Limit: Capability statements shall not exceed 5 pages. Delivery: Submit responses via email to the following Contracting Personnel. Yaa D. Agyepong-Wiafe Operational Contract Support (ASC) Director Area Support Group (ASG) - Jordan Joint Training Center- Jordon Email: yaa.d.agyepongwiafe.mil@army.mil Cassandra. Y Petway SFC, USA Operational Contract Support NCOIC cassandra.y.petway.mil@army.mil, and Hector G Vega, Assistant Director, Hector.g.vega.civ@army.mil Subject Line: Please use the subject line: "Sources Sought Response: ASG-Jordan Logistics Support - [Company Name]".

title: Deschutes National Forest Belly Dump Trailer Reconditioning
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1240BE26Q0108 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for complete reconditioning of two belly dump trailers. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 811310 The small business size standard is $12.5 million This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. Statement of Requirement The Government requires the complete reconditioning of two belly dump trailers. Work includes full structural refurbishment, replacement of critical mechanical systems, and complete modernization of electrical, air, and safety components. Both trailers will undergo full frame inspection and reinforcement, including crack repair, straightening, and replacement or fabrication of structural elements such as crossmembers and push blocks. The requirement includes full suspension and axle replacement, installation of a new kingpin and upper coupler components (if needed), and a complete electrical and air system overhaul from front to back. The trailers� hopper and gate systems will be rebuilt, including installation of a new AR liner, rebushed hinges, and new cylinders. Both trailers will receive new hardware throughout, updated safety equipment, a new landing gear assembly, and a new fender and mudflap system. Additionally, each trailer will be fitted with new wheels and tires. Finally, both trailers must undergo a complete sandblast, surface preparation, priming, and repainting process to restore protective coatings and ensure long?term durability. All work must return the trailers to safe, reliable, and fully operational condition suitable for continued service.

title: Public Environmental Services at Downtown BID
description: Notice of Intent to Issue a Sole Source Contract for public environmental services around the commercial and office buildings, as well as the public spaces within the Downtown BID jurisdiction in Washington DC. Description: The General Services Administration (GSA) Public Building Service (PBS) Acquisition Center for Facilities Management Services (ACFMS) - East intends to issue a sole source contract in accordance with FAR 6.103-1. The proposed contract will include a twelve-month base period and three twelve-month option periods. The contract work will be performed at the Downtown BID jurisdiction in Washington DC. The contract will provide the following services: Cleanliness, Maintenance and Beautification Supplement municipal trash collection by bagging, hauling, and compacting trash and recycling from cans and the ground around GSA buildings for collection by the Department of Public Works. Remove graffiti and other applied vandalism from buildings, sidewalks, and fixtures within 24 hours. Clean dirt, litter, and grime from sidewalks around GSA buildings, and power clean sidewalks and public spaces on a regular basis. Remove gum and gum stains from sidewalks around GSA buildings using specialized mechanical equipment. Paint and visually improve public space elements around GSA buildings, including benches, trash receptacles, poles, lights, tree boxes, newsstands, and other designated fixtures. Plant and maintain flowers, trees, tree boxes, hanging flower baskets, and other landscaping around targeted GSA buildings. Operate a targeted rat abatement program wherever needed in the BID area. Homeless Services Engage a social services agency to provide full-time professional outreach workers to connect individuals experiencing homelessness with essential services, while helping GSA and other property owners eliminate encampments and aggressive panhandling. Coordinate efforts directly with the Department of Health (detox), Department of Mental Health (homeless outreach), Department of Employment Services, and Department of Human Services (food stamps and medical assistance) to deliver resources directly to the downtown homeless population. Focus on connecting the most entrenched population�specifically the severely mentally ill and those battling addictions�with housing recovery programs. Maintain and train a select group of Downtown Safety Ambassadors (SAM) to serve on the Homeless Outreach Service Team (HOST). Expand HOST activities to work with GSA, as well as public and private property managers, to discourage encampments and aggressive panhandling in private spaces. Coordinate outreach efforts with other Business Improvement Districts (BIDs). Develop additional strategies related to the 2nd and D Street shelter to improve the quality of life for GSA and other tenants in adjacent buildings. Expand the BID's education efforts to reach office workers, residents, and visitors. Economic Development Maintain its role as a center for research and information regarding the downtown economy Continue the collection and analysis of data, as well as the production of reports to help inform business and development decisions in the downtown area. Assist in developing financing plans and exploring possibilities for large-scale projects that support downtown infrastructure. General Support to GSA The BID�s professional staff and consultants will be facilitating collaborative planning with GSA and other major downtown stakeholders, including the city and private development community. This effort will address common concerns such as security, transportation and access, environmental issues, and development. The statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition is 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(1) as cited in FAR 6.302-1: �Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements�. Downtown BID is formally registered as a business improvement district in the District of Columbia and is the only firm capable of partnering with property owners in the designated area to provide a comprehensive bundle of enhanced services. These services go beyond the levels provided by other governmental or private sector sources. Currently, there is no other known public or private entity with the broad support and capacity required to simultaneously make the relevant area safe, clean, and user-friendly. The current contract is scheduled to expire on October 6, 2026. GSA will consider any bids, proposals, quotations, or capability statements. Any response shall be submitted via e-mail to Jose Nativisegovia, Contracting Officer via email at jose.nativisegovia@gsa.gov NO LATER THAN Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at 4:00 PM EST. The agency will consider any such submission.

description: Instructions to Offerors Solicitation FA860126Q0131 This combined synopsis/solicitation is expected to result in the award of a firm-fixed-price contract for a BRAND NAME STERIS AMSCO 7052HP Washer/Decontamination Unit FH18072 for the 88th Medical Group at Wright Patterson AFB as described under the requirements section of this combined synopsis/solicitation and accompanying requirements attachment. This combined synopsis/solicitation is prepared in accordance with the format in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only combined synopsis/solicitation; proposals are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. An award, if any, will be made LPTA. Ie, to the lowest priced Offeror who submits a proposal that: 1. Conforms to the requirements of the combined synopsis/solicitation. 2. Receives a rating of "Acceptable" on the Technical Capability evaluation factor. 3. Contains the lowest total evaluated price (TEP), provided that the TEP is not unbalanced and is fair and reasonable. The combined synopsis/solicitation number for this requirement Is FA860126Q0131 and is hereby issued as a Request for Quote (RFQ) using FAR Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Items and FAR Part 13, Simplified Acquisition Procedures. Acceptable means of Submission: All submissions must be submitted electronically to both of the following email addresses, danara.barlow@us.af.mil and jessica.stamper.2@us.af.mil, by 15 September 2026 by 12:00 PM Eastern Daylight Time. Any correspondence sent via email must contain the subject line "FA860126Q0131 Washer/Decontamination Unit" The entire proposal must be contained in a single email, unless otherwise approved, including attachments. Please note: due to the email server, any emails that exceed 5 megabytes might not go through. Emails with compressed files are not permitted. Note that email filters at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base are designed to filter emails without subject lines or with suspicious subject lines or content (i.e., .exe or .zip files). Therefore, if the specified subject line is not included, the e-mail may not get through the email filters. Also be advised that .zip or .exe files are not allowable attachments and may be deleted by the email filters at Wright-Patterson. If sending attachments with email, ensure only .pdf, .doc, .docx, .xls or .xlsx documents are sent. The email filter may delete any other form of attachments. A confirmation email will be sent once the proposal is received. If you do not receive a confirmation email within 24 hours of submitting the proposal, please reach out to the point of contact listed on the solicitation. Submittal of proposals in response to this combined synopsis/solicitation constitutes agreement by the Offeror to all terms & conditions contained herein, which will also be the terms & conditions of any resulting contract. It is the Offerors responsibility to be familiar with the applicable clauses and provisions. Clauses and provisions in full text may be accessed via the Internet website https://www.acquisition.gov. The Government reserves the right to award without discussions or make no award depending upon the quality, price fairness, and price reasonableness of the proposals received. Period of Performance: Installation to begin no later than 120 days after awarded finishes and design is finalized. Delivery Destination: Identified in SOW Delivery Type: FOB Destination (As defined in FAR 2.101Definitions, the seller or consignor is responsible for the cost of shipping and risk of loss.) Inspection and Acceptance: Both inspection and acceptance will be by the Government at Destination. Requirement: Washer/Decontamination Unit Contract Type: The anticipated award is Firm-Fixed Price. Basis for Award: The Government will award a contract resulting from this RFQ to the Offeror responsible whose offer conforms to the requirements outlined in Attachment 1 (SOW) and is the lowest evaluated price of proposals meeting or exceeding the acceptability standards. Technical Capability and Price will be used to evaluate all offers. Technical or Quality: The proposal will be evaluated to the extent to which it can meet and/or exceed the Government's requirements as outlined in the solicitation and based on the information requested in the instructions to offerors section of the solicitation. Price: The Government will evaluate the price by adding the total of all line item prices, including all options. The proposals may be in any format but MUST include: 1. Proposing company's name, address, DUNS number, Cage Code, and TIN. 2. Point of contact's name, phone, and email. 3. Proposal number & date. 4. Timeframe that the proposal is valid. 5. Individual item price. 6. Total price, No Progress Payments. Important Notice to Contractors: Proposals MUST also contain a complete description of items offered and any technical manuals or literature to clearly show that the items meet or exceed the requirements outlined in the Statement of Work (Attachment 1). Important Notice to Contractors: All prospective awardees are required to register at the System for Award Management (SAM) and to maintain active registration during the life of the contract. SAM can be accessed at https://www.sam.gov. Any award resulting from this combined synopsis/solicitation will include DFARS Clause 252.232-7003, Electronic Submission of Payment Requests. Section 1008 of the National Defense Authorization Act of Fiscal Year 2001 requires any claims for payment (invoices) under DoD contract to be submitted in electronic form. Wide Area Workflow Receipt and Acceptance (WAWF RA) is the DoD system of choice for implementing this statutory requirement. Use of the basic system is at no cost to the contractor. Contractors must complete vendor training, which is also available at no cost at http://www.wawftraining.com. Prior to submitting invoices in the production system, contractors must register for an account at http://wawf.eb.mil/. NOTICE: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Requirement: To be considered for this acquisition, all offerors must be CMMC certified at the time of quote submission. Offerors must ensure their current CMMC status and corresponding NIST SP 800-171 assessment scores are actively documented and verifiable within the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) prior to submitting a quote. ADDITIONAL INSTRUCTIONS TO OFFERORS: The following paragraphs in the provision at FAR 52.212-1-Instructions to Offerors-Commercial Items are tailored as follows: (a) North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code and small business size standard are as specified in the solicitation document. (b) Submission of offers is as prescribed in the text of this combined synopsis/solicitation. Proposal Content: The proposals may be in any format, but shall consist of two separate parts, a technical proposal and a price proposal. Proposal Detail: The proposal shall be clear, concise, and shall include sufficient detail for effective evaluation and for substantiating the validity of stated claims. The proposal should not simply rephrase or restate the Government's requirements, but rather shall provide convincing rationale to address how the offeror intends to meet the listed requirements. Offerors shall assume that the Government has no prior knowledge of their facilities and experience, and will base its evaluation on the information presented in the offer submitted. Embellishments Not Desired: Elaborate brochures or documentation, binding, detailed artwork or other embellishments are unnecessary and are not desired.

title: Z1DA--657-24-111JC FCA-Renovate Ambassador Suite & Main Lobby B1
description: Presolicitation Notice Presolicitation Notice Page 5 of 5 Presolicitation Notice *=Required Field Presolicitation Notice Page 1 of 5 DESCRIPTION TITLE OF PROJECT: 657-24-111JC FCA-Renovate Ambassador Suite & Main Lobby B1 Solicitation 36C25526R0167 Scope of work: The General Description: VA Saint Louis Health Care System, John Cochran Division, requires a Construction Contractor to renovate the Ambassador entrance, entrance corridor, and Ambassador Suite to improve patient and ADA access to the building, fix moisture and leaking issues with the existing skylight, update finishes, improve patient circulation, and optimize space for the existing functions operating in the area. The Main Entrance of Bldg. 1 will be updated to facilitate visitor traffic flow and experience. Issues to be resolved include improving patient and ADA access to the building, fix moisture and leaking issues with the existing skylight, update finishes, improve patient circulation, optimize space for the existing functions operating in the area, HVAC deficiencies, electrical deficiencies including an electrical closet within the space, and any other Facilities Conditions Assessment deficiencies located within this listed area. The Main Entrance of Bldg. 1 will be updated to facilitate visitor traffic flow and experience. The existing revolving door will be replaced with an airlock of sliding and swinging doors with automatic controls. This project has a set of drawings and specifications that have been created by an Architectural-Engineering firm. These drawings and specifications indicate the work to be performed. Work includes, but is not limited to, general construction, alterations, mechanical and electrical work, utility systems, necessary demolition and removal of existing structures, associated appurtenances and certain other items necessary completion. All work shall be performed in accordance with solicitation/contract terms and conditions, specifications and drawings, and all applicable VA TIL and local and National codes. Contractor shall furnish all supervision, tools, labor, materials, equipment, transportation and testing necessary. Contractor will perform site investigations to fully inform themselves of the conditions and limitations applied to the work. All project work shall be installed in accordance with all applicable standards available at time of installation to include published commercial specifications as well as standards and preferences expressed in this document. All installation details shall be fully coordinated with VA CO and on-site Contracting Officer s Representative (COR). Period of Performance for all work is 330 calendar days. The facility location is the John Cochran VA Medical Center 915 N Grand Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63106. Pursuant to 38 USC 8127(d) and in accordance with Public Law 109-461, the Veterans Benefits, Healthcare and Information Technology Act of 2006, this procurement is set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB). The estimated cost magnitude is between $1,000,000-$5,000,000 (FAR 36.204). The North American Industry Classification Code (NAICS) for this procurement is 236220 (Commercial and Institutional Building Construction) with a small business size standard of $45.0 million. The duration of the project is estimated to be 330 calendar days after receipt of notice to proceed. This completion period includes final inspection and clean-up. Award will be made utilizing the Best Value Lowest Price Technically Acceptable Source Selection Process in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 15.101-2. Proposal submission instructions and project specific instructions will be included in the solicitation package. The government plans to award without discussions but reserves the right to hold discussions if necessary. The offeror is responsible to monitor and download any amendments from the System of Award Management (SAM) Business Opportunities (https://sam.gov/) website, which may be issued to this pre-solicitation. The successful prime contractor must perform no less than 85 percent of the General Construction labor for NAICS Code 236220. Proposal submission instructions will be included in the solicitation package. The government plans to award without discussions but reserves the right to hold discussions if necessary. The offeror is responsible to monitor and download any amendments from the System of Award Management (SAM) Business Opportunities (https://sam.gov/) website, which may be issued to this pre-solicitation. In accordance with FAR 52.204-7, registration in SAM is required and in accordance with FAR 2.101, prospective contractors must be registered in SAM under the applicable NAICS code. Additionally, in accordance with the Veterans Affairs Acquisition Regulation (VAAR) 819.7003, only businesses verified under the applicable NAICS and listed in the small business administration (SBA) registry https://veterans.certify.sba.gov, shall be considered. Firms may obtain SAM information at https://www.sam.gov and VIP information at Veteran Small Business Certification at https://veterans.certify.sba.gov. The solicitation package and drawings should be available for download on or before September 15, 2026, and the proposal due date will be on or about October 22, 2026. An organized site visit will be scheduled, and the information will be made available at time of solicitation issuance. Only one site visit will be scheduled and interested offerors are highly encouraged to attend. No hard copies of the solicitation or drawings will be provided; and telephone requests or questions will NOT be accepted. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. Statement of Requirement The Government requires the complete reconditioning of two belly dump trailers. Work includes full structural refurbishment, replacement of critical mechanical systems, and complete modernization of electrical, air, and safety components. Both trailers will undergo full frame inspection and reinforcement, including crack repair, straightening, and replacement or fabrication of structural elements such as crossmembers and push blocks. The requirement includes full suspension and axle replacement, installation of a new kingpin and upper coupler components (if needed), and a complete electrical and air system overhaul from front to back. The trailers� hopper and gate systems will be rebuilt, including installation of a new AR liner, rebushed hinges, and new cylinders. Both trailers will receive new hardware throughout, updated safety equipment, a new landing gear assembly, and a new fender and mudflap system. Additionally, each trailer will be fitted with new wheels and tires. Finally, both trailers must undergo a complete sandblast, surface preparation, priming, and repainting process to restore protective coatings and ensure long?term durability. All work must return the trailers to safe, reliable, and fully operational condition suitable for continued service.

title: Dry Ice Blaster for Parylene Removal from FLASH Memory Modules
description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS, AN INVITATION FOR BIDS, OR A REQUEST FOR QUOTATIONS. FURTHER, IT DOES NOT REPRESENT A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT TO PAY FOR COSTS INCURRED IN PREPARATION AND SUBMISSION OF DATA OR ANY OTHER COSTS INCURRED IN RESPONSE TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. This is a Special Notice (PUR260177) with the intent to award a sole source purchase order to Cold Jet, LLC (COLD JET), under the authority of FAR 13.106-1 based on their unique technical qualifications as the only known provider of the brand name �COLD JET i3 MicroClean dry ice blaster�. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) knows of no other sources for this requirement. Notice is provided as information to the marketplace, market research, and is an invitation for any other qualified companies to express their interest in and demonstrate their capability to provide the required equipment. The NTSB is an independent Federal agency with the primary missions of investigating civil aviation accidents in the United States and significant accidents in the other modes of transportation -- railroad, highway, marine, pipeline, and commercial space -- and issuing safety recommendations aimed at preventing future accidents. The NTSB has a requirement for delivery and setup of one (1) COLD JET CO2 dry ice blasting machine to perform precision removal of Parylene conformal coating from printed circuit boards containing non-volatile FLASH memory devices. The Recorders Laboratory has an urgent need to develop a high-throughput method for the removal of the Parylene conformal coatings increasingly used in the aerospace industry. Micro-blasting is the most promising avenue for a high-throughput method adaptable to wide variety of complex surface geometries and conditions. A large variety of abrasive media is available for use depending on the application. One major concern when using dielectric abrasives for the blasting medium is the potential for Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) generation. While some particulate systems are now available that incorporate multiple ESD-mitigation strategies, the efficacy of these systems has not been internally evaluated for the removal of Parylene from inaccessible areas under and behind the pins of a Thin Small Outline Package (TSOP) package without spiking local ESD levels or damaging the pins and underlying Printed Circuit Board (PCB). Another concern is the selection, management, and disposal of residual abrasives material � which cannot be re-used. Most of these concerns can be mitigated by the use of CO2 ice as the blasting material � which this requirement addresses. The decision to award a sole source purchase order is because the Cold Jet i3 MicroClean dry ice blaster is the only known equipment that meets NTSB�s requirement. The only known source of this instrument is from COLD JET. The NTSB has an urgent need to perform work in a timely and responsive manner by replicating a known effective process for accomplishing this work that can be duplicated in the NTSB Recorder Laboratory using the equipment to be acquired. Sources capable of fully satisfying the above requirements are invited to submit capability statements/expressions of interest providing the government the necessary information to determine actual capability. At a minimum, this information, which must be prepared specifically in response to this notice should, must include: (1) identification of company or organization; (2) an assertion of existing, full capability to meet proposed requirements; (3) business/contracts/marketing office point(s) of contact; (4) notification of business size and /or special status; and (5) any additional information that may be useful to the successful procurement of the requirements, if solicited. These expressions of interest shall adhere to a five (5)-page submission limit plus web links and any specialized product descriptions. The statement of qualifications should include only information that clearly demonstrates the respondent's capabilities, expertise, and experience to provide the requirements described in this notice. General marketing material should not be included. The NTSB prefers that companies do not submit proprietary material. However, the government recognizes that proprietary data may be a part of your submittal. If so, clearly mark such restricted or proprietary data and present it as an addendum to the non-restricted/non-proprietary information. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. A determination by the government not to compete the proposed purchase order based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the government. All responsible sources may submit a capability statement, which shall be considered by NTSB. Parties must submit information within five (5) days of publication of this notice. NTSB will not return capability statements and the supporting documentation submitted in response to this notice. Telephone responses and inquiries will not be accepted. You may email questions regarding this notice to the issuing office to Bryan J. Moy via email at: bryan.moy@ntsb.gov.

title: Titan Dorm Furniture Delivery, Installation, and De-Installation Services
description: The 30th Contracting Squadron (30 CONS/PKB) at Vandenberg SFB, CA, is conducting market research to identify capable sources for a combined commercial supply and service requirement at Titan Dorm (Building 13135). Products Required: 88 Twin XL Bunkable Bedframes: Solid hardwood/hardwood veneer construction, durable institutional finish, tool-less/hook assembly, integrated wire spring support, designed to seat 38" x 80" mattresses. 88 Twin XL Innerspring Mattresses: Finished dimensions 38" x 80" x 8"�11", firm, reversible, heavy-duty innerspring coils with continuous border wire butt-welded for perimeter edge support, institutional fluid-proof/bedbug-resistant ticking, fully compliant with 16 CFR Part 1632 and 16 CFR Part 1633. Services & Facility Constraints: Inside Delivery & Assembly: Unloading, staging, full assembly, placement, and leveling across 44 rooms (two standalone, unbunked beds per room; rooms measure 8' x 8'). Complete removal and off-base disposal of all packing debris. De-Installation & Haul-Away: Dismantle, remove, and transport 44 existing Full XL bedframes and mattresses from Building 13135 to the base warehouse facility. Multi-Story Stairwell Access (No Elevators): Building 13135 has no passenger or freight elevators. All new items must be manually carried up stairwells (clear stairwell width: 36.5 inches), and all removed assets must be manually carried down stairwells. Critical Schedule Feasibility Meeting the required project timeline is critical. Full building access is available 1 October 2026. Target/desired installation completion date is 16 November 2026. Mandatory Final Completion Date: All delivery, full assembly, and removal services must be 100% complete NO LATER THAN (NLT) 4 December 2026. Responders must explicitly state their manufacturing lead time and provide written confirmation of their ability to guarantee on-site delivery and completed installation by 4 December 2026. If unable to meet this date, vendors must provide their absolute earliest guaranteed completion date. Submission Details & Optional ROM Interested vendors are requested to submit a brief capability statement addressing: Schedule Feasibility: Confirmation of guaranteed completion NLT 4 December 2026 and total lead time from award. Technical Compliance: Brief confirmation that offered products meet the salient characteristics. Logistics Capability: Confirmation of ability to execute multi-story manual stairwell carries without elevator support. Contract Vehicles & Socio-Economic Status: Company name, CAGE, SAM Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), business size standard under NAICS 337121/337122, and any active GSA MAS contracts. Optional Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM): Vendors are encouraged to submit an optional, non-binding ROM breakdown covering: 88 Bedframes 88 Mattresses Freight to Vandenberg SFB (Zip 93437) On-site assembly, staging, and leveling labor De-installation, haul-away, and warehouse delivery labor

title: NCSU Locum Physician Services Sole Source Notice
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE-SOURCE ACQUISITION Description: This is a notice of intent to award a sole-source contract and is not a request for competitive quotes. The Billings Area Indian Health Service intends to award a sole-source purchase order to Watanabe Enterprises for Locum Physician Services for the period of performance December 1, 2026 through January 30, 2027. The Government intends to use the procedures at 12.102(b), 12.201-1, and 6.103-1, subject to the approved acquisition strategy and determination that only one source is reasonably available. The sole-source action is necessary to ensure continuity of critical medical provider services at the Northern Cheyenne Service Unit while the Government completes the competitive acquisition and award of the follow-on requirement. Watanabe Enterprises currently has qualified and credentialed medical providers available to continue providing the required services during this limited interim period, thereby preventing a lapse in essential patient-care services. See attached Performance Work Statement for details. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals or quotations. Any party who believes it can perform this requirement should submit a capability statement for consideration by the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Interested parties may identify their interest and submit a capability statement no later than September 15th, 2026 at 2pm Mountain Standard Time. title: WASTEWATER PRETREATMENT PLANT OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE SERVICES
description: The Bureau of Engraving & Printing�s (BEP) Facility located in Washington, DC contains an Industrial Wastewater Pretreatment Plant (WWPP). BEP�s objective is to procure contractor services to manage, operate, maintain supplies and perform maintenance and provide technical support for the Wastewater and Storm Water Programs. The WWPP requires services to support the BEP on a 24/7 basis. title: Networked Ride Control System (RCS) Electronics Renewal Package
description: Notice Identifier: 145022-26-0047 Notice The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), Air Resources Laboratory (ARL), intends to negotiate and award a sole-source purchase order under the authority of FAR 13.106-1(b)(1) to Naiad Dynamics US, Inc. No set-aside is used for this requirement. The associated NAICS code is 334511. Agency Contracting Office Address & Point of Contact: Barbara Shifflett NOAA/ARL 456 S. Illinois Ave. Oak Ridge, TN 37831 Description Project/Vessel Title: USN SWATH 40ASC � Networked RCS System Upgrade Place of Performance: Grand Haven, Michigan Period of Performance: Date of Award through September 18, 2027 This requirement is for the procurement of a Networked Ride Control System (RCS) Electronics Renewal Package manufactured by Naiad Dynamics US, Inc. The system consists of a next-generation Distributed Control System (DCS/NDCS) utilizing a Controller Area Network (CAN) bus architecture. It functions as an active Total Ride Control System (TRCS) that continuously modulates the vessel's existing canard and stabilizer fins using precision electro-hydraulic servo valves and closed-loop digital feedback. This upgrade replaces obsolete RCS electronics to mitigate pitch, roll, and heave accelerations, directly reducing operator fatigue and motion sickness while maintaining critical ship stabilization. Sole Source Justification NOAA has determined that Naiad Dynamics US, Inc. is the sole manufacturer and authorized distributor capable of supplying the specific Networked Ride Control System (RCS) Electronics Renewal Package designed to integrate seamlessly with the vessel's existing stabilization infrastructure. Instructions for Potential Responders This presolicitation notice is not a request for competitive proposals, and no solicitation package is available. However, firms that believe they can fully meet the Government's requirements may submit substantiating capability documentation or a written request for additional information to the Point of Contact. Submission Deadline: All documentation must be received in writing within 15 calendar days after the publication of this pre-solicitation notice. Submission Format: Written submissions must be delivered via email or mail to the designated Point of Contact. Oral communications will not be accepted in response to this notice. Responses and documentation will be evaluated solely to determine whether to conduct this procurement on a competitive basis. A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement based on responses to this notice remains solely within the discretion of the Government.

title: Romania – Vocational training services – Servicii de formare profesională pentru consolidarea competențelor în domeniul performanței fondurilor UE - cod SMIS 318850
description: Obiectul achiziției este furnizarea unui pachet integrat de servicii de formare profesională pentru consolidarea competențelor beneficiarilor fondurilor europene și ale personalului din sistemul de management și control în domeniul indicatorilor, al cadrului de performanță și al colectării, prelucrării, analizei și utilizării datelor. Contractul cuprinde două activități complementare de formare profesională: a) program de formare profesională destinat personalului implicat în elaborarea și implementarea proiectelor finanțate din fondurile Politicii de Coeziune; b) program de perfecționare profesională destinat personalului din sistemul de management și control, în domeniul prelucrării și analizei statistice a datelor, proiectat și desfășurat prin utilizarea unui software statistic specializat. Se solicită operatorilor economici să-și păstreze valabilitatea ofertei 6 luni de la data limită de depunere a ofertelor. Durata contractului: 24 luni de la momentul semnării contractului de către ultima parte Valoarea estimata: 1.680.230,40 lei, exclusiv TVA Garanția de participare : Nu este cazul. Garanția de bună execuție: se solicită constituirea garanției de bună execuție în valoare de 10 % din valoarea contractului fără TVA. În conformitate cu prevederile art. 154 alin. (3) și alin (4) din Legea nr. 98/2016, cu modificările și completările ulterioare, având în vedere specificul serviciilor ce fac obiectul prezentei achiziții, în scopul asigurării autorității contractante privind îndeplinirea cerințelor calitative a serviciilor și în perioada convenită a contractului, se consideră necesară constituirea garanției de bună execuție a contractului de către operatorul economic semnatar al contractului. Potrivit art. 154 alin. (3) din Legea nr. 98/2016, cu modificările și completările ulterioare, se stabileste valoarea garanției de bună execuție prin raportare la complexitatea contractului într-un cuantum corespunzător unui procent de 10% din valoarea contractului, fără TVA. Perioada de valabilitate a garanţiei de bună execuție va fi egală cu durata contractului. Data limită pentru depunerea ofertei: 05.10.2026 (minim 30 zile de la data transmiterii spre publicare), ora 23:59 la adresa de e-mail lucian.mihai@mfe.gov.ro. description: ДСП се създава за доставка на различни видове медицински изделия и консумативи за нуждите на ,,МБАЛ -Благоевград" АД. Първоначално планиранираната "Техническа спецификация" може да бъде частично променяна в хода на провеждане на динамичната система, като се добавят нови медицински изделия и/или консумативи и/или се променят количествата им. Посочените количества в приложената към документацията „Техническа спецификация" са прогнозни и не пораждат задължение за Възложителя да ги възложи в прогнозния обем. Фактическото изпълнение на обществената поръчка ще се определи на базата на реално доставените медицински изделия и консумативи, в рамките на финансовия ресурс. Обменът на документи и съобщения между Възложители, кандидати, участници и изпълнители на обществени поръчки се осъществява чрез Централизираната електронна платформа. Срокът на ДСП е 36 месеца . Динамичната система за покупки е отворена през целия си срок на действие за всеки кандидат, който отговаря на критериите за подбор. Достъпът и участието в нея са свободни и безплатни за всички заинтересовани лица. Срок на договорите, сключвани въз основа на ограничените поръчки в рамките на ДСП е за период от 12 /дванадесет/ месеца. Динамичната система за покупки (ДСП) се провежда на етапи. Съгласно чл.101 от ЗОП, в зависимост от етапа на процедурата кандидатите подават заявления за участие, а квалифицираните (допуснати) кандидати - оферти. ДСП се управлява като изцяло електронен процес и през целия срок на действие на системата за покупки тя е открита за всеки стопански субект /изпълняващ орган/ИО/, който отговаря на критериите за подбор. Посочените критерии за подбор, са и критерии за изключване. Възложителят осигурява пълен, неограничен и пряк достъп до документацията по настоящата процедура чрез Централизираната електронна платформа, наричана "платформата". Заявленията и офертите трябва да се изготвят и представят в съответствие с изискванията на чл. 101 от ЗОП и чл.47 от ППЗОП, в срока посочен в обявлението. Всяко заявление и Всяка оферта се подава в системата на ЦАИС ЕОП Първи етап /първоначално събиране на заявления за участие/: Квалифициране на доставчиците ( допускане на доставчиците до системата ) . На този етап се събират заявления за участие. Заявленията за участие /ЕЕДОП/ съдържа/т информация относно личното състояние на кандидатите и критериите за подбор. Краен срок за подаване на първоначални заявления - 25.09.2026 г. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие ще се извърши в срок до 10 работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на първоначални заявления. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички първоначални заявления. Заявления могат да се подават и след крайния срок за подаване на първоначални заявления, в тези случаи кандидатите ще получават покани след одобряване на включването им в ДСП. Възложителят определя с Решение за подбор квалифицираните доставчици. След влизане в сила на Решението за подбор следва втори етап на процедурата. Втори етап /събиране на оферти по конкретни покани/: Следва изпращане на покана за представяне на оферти за конкретна обществена поръчка до тези доставчици, които са били квалифицирани/допуснати. Офертите съдържат техническо и ценово предложение. Съгласно чл.39, ал.1 от ППЗОП с подаването на оферта се счита, че кандидатите се съгласяват с всички условия на възложителя, в т.ч. с определения от него срок на валидност на офертите и с проекта на договор. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички първоначални заявления, подадени в посоченият по-горе срок. При конкретни поръчки по покани офертите ще бъдат класирани от програма, която ще е достъпна и безплатна за всички кандидати. Осигурен е неограничен, пълен и пряк достъп до документацията за обществената поръчка през целия срок на действие на ДСП. *По всяко време заинтересовани лица могат да подават заявления за допускане/включване в ДСП. Възложителят ще разглежда новопостъпилите предложения два пъти в месеца (1- во и 15-то число на месеца ) или на две седмици веднъж. Възложителят ще издава решение за допускане на кандидатите в ДСП. След всяко разглеждане на заявленията Възложителят издава Решение за подбор с което квалифицираните доставчици се присъединяват към ДСП.

title: 13--Taser 10 for South Atlantic Gulf SERO
description: EO 14398, Taser 10 for South Atlantic Gulf SERO The National Park Service, Region 2, South Atlantic Gulf, intends to award a Firm Fixed price contract for Conducted Energy Weapons (CEWs) AKA Tasers to support law enforcement activities and the mission of keeping the public safe. This purchase supports the lifecycle replacement of hardware. DOI's 446 DM 22, Conducted Energy Weapons, states that CEWs are a less-lethal hand-held device that discharges electrical pulses designed to temporarily incapacitate a person by inhibiting the person's neuromuscular control. Deploying a CEW allows officers to safely control subjects from a modest distance, minimizing risk. These Tasers are required to be fully supported by the existing hardware-to-software ecosystem solution currently in use by the Department of the Interior. This requirement is being procured in accordance with FAR Part 6.302-1, only one responsible source. The determination to select Axion Enterprise is that they are the only provider of a fully integrated hardware to software system which includes electronic control devices and digital evidence management which contains all of the necessary components to provide a complete end-to-end solution for the capture, management, and security of digital evidence captured from Trilogy logs (pulse duration, battery health, discharge times) of the Taser 10 Conducted Energy Weapon. The fundamental purpose of this system is to reliably capture, manage, and secure digital evidence in a manner that ensures its integrity, preserves the chain of custody, and guarantees its admissibility in judicial, civil and administrative proceedings. These products are required to be compatible with existing and future systems. The results of the capability determination have demonstrated that Axon Enterprise is the only vendor who is capable to fulfill the Governments need for conducted energy weapons which are a part of a hardware to software ecosystem solution which is FEDRamp High compliant to support law enforcement operations. Additionally, it is in the best interest of the Government to utilize this contractor to decrease potential costs on the overall project by saving on unnecessary costs of new hardware and software for compatibility. Since the Axion is the original contractor of current systems that are in place, it is the only source that can provide the product required for this requirement. NAICS Code: 332992, Small Arms Ammunition Manufacturing , Standard business size is 1300. The National Park Service is presently using SAM/FBO to issue synopsis for Notice of Intent to Award Sole Source Justifications and Sources Sought. The synopsis may be viewed online at: https://beta.sam.gov. FBO will be the only means of obtaining the amendments and will be able to receive electronic notification of solicitations and awards. CAUTION: This synopsis will be issued electronically as will any amendments. The Government is under no obligation to maintain a bidder's list. It is incumbent for any interested parties to obtain any amendments which may be issued. All questions pertaining to the synopsis can be directed to celinda_hicks@ios.doi.gov or by calling 470-819-0814. This is a sources sought for interested vendors for this project. A solicitation will not be released for this requirement. This will be a notice of intent to award on a sole source basis to Axion Enterprise.

title: Rockwell BOA Order for PACS Shipboard Material II
description: This solicitation notice is to document that solicitation N6449826Q5273 was issued to Rockwell Automation, Inc. on 09 September 2026. The Department of the Navy, Naval Surface Warfare Center, Philadelphia Division (NSWCPD). Intends to negotiate and award a Basic Ordering Agreement (BOA) Order under BOA N6449824G4001 to Rockwell Automation Inc., 1 Allen Bradley Drive, Cleveland, OH 44124 (Rockwell) for the procurement of PACS materials. The Government intends to make an award in the 1st quarter of Fiscal Year 2027. This is part of a follow-on procurement for this requirement. Pursuant to 10.U.S.C 2304(c)(l), Rockwell Automatic, Inc. is the only responsible source of capable of fulfilling the Navy's requirements for the specified materials. The proposed BOA Order award is for supplies for which the Government intended to solicit and negotiate with only one source under the authority of FAR 6.302. This notice is not a request for competitive proposals. Interested parties, however, may identify their interest and capability by responding to the notice. The Government will consider all information received prior to the closing date of this notice. Information received will normally be considered soley for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement in the future. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract action based upon responses to this notice is soley within the discretion of the Government. Responses shall be made in writing by email to the attention of Kimesha Speller via email at Kimesha.l.Speller.civ@us.navy.mil by 5:00 PM Eastern on 25 September 2026.

title: Fuel Tank Removal and Replacement, Colebrook River Lake, Colebrook, CT
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers � New England District is issuing a Solicitation Notice for Fuel Tank Removal and Replacement, Colebrook River Lake, Colebrook, CT. THE WORK CONSISTS OF: The Contractor shall furnish all labor, materials, and equipment necessary to remove and dispose of one existing 600 gallon fuel tank with a catch basin filled with roughly 300 gallons of fuel, a 10 gallon day tank, fuel transfer pump, and the respective fuel/supply lines, and replace with two (2) new 275 gallon insulated, double walled fuel tanks, a new 10 gallon day tank, as well as dedicated grounding systems, fuel transfer pump, vent pipes, fill whistle, crossover/manifold kit, fill caps, fuel level gauges, tie down kit, and install new fuel/supply return lines in the Colebrook River Lake gatehouse. All work will be performed in a timely manner to the satisfaction of the Technical Point of Contact and in accordance with the Statement of Work and in accordance with local, state, and federal laws. The magnitude of construction is less than $25,000. For additional information on construction contracts awarded to small businesses please visit: Partnering With Us (army.mil). This procurement is set-aside for small business vendors. The applicable NAICS code is 237120 with a Small Business Size Standard of $45 Million. ALL VENDORS MUST HAVE AN ACTIVE REGISTRATION IN SAM.GOV AT THE TIME OF SUBMISSION IN ORDER TO BE CONSIDERED. ANY VENDOR THAT DOES NOT HAVE AN ACTIVE SAM.GOV REGISTRATION WILL BE REJECTED AS NON RESPONSIVE.

title: GAOA LDV Crystal Lakes Water & Septic Resuscitation, PSICC, Colorado
description: This project involves installing a new 2-inch HDPE waterline beneath Colorado Highway 24, including completing all Subsurface Utility Engineering required for CDOT permitting. Work includes connecting the new waterline from Dwelling 1 to the existing distribution system, replacing the well pump to provide a 15 GPM supply, installing a dual?stage booster pump and basement water storage, and performing associated electrical upgrades such as relocating meters, burying service lines, upgrading panels, and supporting septic and booster pump systems. The project also replaces multiple septic systems serving the Blue House, Brown House, Bunkhouse, and Shop, installs new sewer and dosing infrastructure, and includes asphalt removal along with new road and gate installation.

title: V-22 Standby Flight Display
description: The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR), V-22 Joint Program Office (PMA-275) intends to negotiate and award a Delivery Order under Basic Ordering Agreement (BOA) N00019-23-G-0001 to ELBITAMERICA, INC., 4700 Marine Creek Pkwy, Fort Worth, TX 76179 on a sole source basis for: The Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) for the redesign of the V-22 Standby Flight Display (SFD), the procurement and installation of redesigned kits, and the sustainment of legacy SFD Weapon Replaceable Assemblies (WRAs) on V-22 aircraft. This action is being awarded on a sole source basis to ELBITAMERICA, INC. in accordance with the statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition under Title 10 U.S.C 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR Part 6.103-1, �Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements.� ELBITAMERICA, INC. is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the SFD. The Government does not possess (or cannot provide) the data necessary to perform the required repairs of the items. Consequently, ELBITAMERICA, INC. is the only responsible source with the necessary access to the technical data and requisite expertise to perform the contemplated effort within the required schedule. The proposed contract action is for supplies or services for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source under authority of FAR 6.103. Interested persons may identify their interest and capability to respond to the requirement. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. However, any capability statements received within fifteen days after date of publication of this notice will be considered by the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. title: Shatter Resistant Window Film Notice
description: SUBJECT Reminder: Due Date of December 31, 2016, for Window Film Manufacturers to Comply with SD-STD-03.01 Revision A Performance Requirements or be Removed from the DS-Approved List of SRWF Products for Department of State Applications The Department of State has developed a new standard, SD-STD-01.03 Revision A, Performance Standard for Window Film for Department of State Applications. The Bureau of Diplomatic Security (DS) maintains the DS-Approved List of SRWF Products for Department of State Applications. Only SRWF products included on this list are authorized for installation in Department facilities. New SRWF products that meet the following performance requirements are eligible to be added to that list: Performance standards per SD-STD-03.01 Revision A Meet class A or Class I under ASTM E 84 flame test. Surface Abrasion, in haze not to exceed 3.2 percent following 100 turns, using 500-gram weights on a CS10F abrasive wheel when tested in accordance with ASTM D 1044 Products already on the DS-Approved List of SRWF Products for Department of State Applications will be required to pass the testing requirements outlined above by on December 31th, 2026 to remain on the list. New film products are required to pass these testing requirements to be put on the DS-Approved List. The SD-STD-03.01 Revision A is currently a Department of State standard; however, we are actively coordinating with ASTM International to have this be developed into an official ASTM standard. Questions regarding this notification or implementation of SD-STD-01.03 Revision A should be directed to PSD/RD staff at DSPSPRD@STATE.GOV.

title: 66--Notice of Intent to Sole Source ImaCore 3D Imager
description: In accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 12 - Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services, the Department of Energy (DOE), National Energy Technology Laboratory (NETL) intends to negotiate and award a purchase order on a sole source basis to Green Imaging Technologies Inc. NETL requires this 3D Rock Core Imager as it will allow NETL to significantly enhance and improve its subsurface research capabilities. This instrument provides cutting-edge solutions to better evaluate petrophysical features and multi-phase fluid flow of geologic cores and wellbore cement. This system is patent-protected and proprietary to Green Imaging Technologies Inc. and is specifically engineered to operate seamlessly with NETL�s existing Oxford GeoSpec NMR P10 Overburden Cell. This compatible technology is required to maintain experimental continuity, prevent data corruption from system discrepancies, and ensure direct quantitative comparisons with NETL�s historical and ongoing rock core datasets. This is considered a sole source to Green Imaging Technologies Inc. because to the best of NETL�s knowledge, Green Imaging Technologies Inc. is the only known source that can provide the required instrument. No known potential alternate sources exist which could satisfy this requirement. This notice of intent is not a request or quote/proposal. Any interested party that believes it is capable of meeting the NETL requirement described herein may identify themselves and must provide evidence of their capability to fulfill the requirement being requested by 1700 PM EDT on September 15, 2026. Responses must be submitted in writing to the Contract Specialist David Lahey, via email at David.Lahey@netl.doe.gov no later than the time and date noted above. Telephone responses and requests will not be received. A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct competitive procurement.

title: Household Goods Moving, Shipping, Transportation, and Storage Service Providers Software Integration Request for Information
description: INTRODUCTION The Personal Property Activity (PPA) is conducting market research to understand how integrating vendor systems with a government central platform via an Application Programming Interface (API) will affect household goods (HHG) moving, shipping, transportation, and storage service providers. Accordingly, the PPA invites industry partners and service providers to submit detailed information regarding integration costs, associated software development timelines, standard industry practices, and recommendations for testing and risk mitigation when connecting their internal software systems to a central Government platform. This Request for Information (RFI) enables industry stakeholders to provide direct feedback on how this type of integration will impact their current systems and operations, helping to shape future technical requirements and acquisition decisions. This RFI is issued solely for informational and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation for proposals. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot form a binding contract. The PPA is not under any obligation to pursue any acquisition alternative based on this RFI, and the Government will not compensate respondents for any information received. All submissions will be kept confidential, will become the property of the U.S. Government, and will not be returned. SUBMISSION DEADLINE Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 4:00 PM CDT POINTS OF CONTACT (POCs) The preferred method of communication with the POCs is email. RFI submissions and questions must be submitted via email to all points of contact. Contracting Officer: Chris Frost; christopher.t.frost4.civ@mail.mil Contracts Specialist: Kevin Peaslee: kevin.p.peaslee.mil@mail.mil Technical Lead: Kipp Reed; kipp.t.reed.civ@mail.mil IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS Interested parties are advised to read the attached RFI in its entirety.

title: Tactical Air-Launched Weapon Demonstrating Industrialization
description: NOTICE OF CONTRACTING ACTION Broad Agency Announcement: FA2391-23-S-2403 Pioneering Aerospace Capabilities, Engineering and Research (PACER) CALL Name: Tactical Air-Launched Weapon Demonstrating Industrialization The Department of the Air Force, Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL), Air Warfare Directorate (RA), hereby provides notice of its intent to issue a focused call under the active Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) entitled, �Pioneering Aerospace Capabilities, Engineering & Research (PACER)� (Solicitation Number FA2391-23-S-2403). This anticipated call will solicit innovative solutions for producing an operationally relevant, air-launched hypersonic weapon for less than 1/5 the cost and greater than 5x the production rate of current systems. Offerors are encouraged to consider modular, open architectures together with aggressive application of design for manufacturing and digital engineering principles. The evaluation process will be conducted in a single round; offerors will be invited to submit full technical and cost proposals. Specific technical objectives, evaluation criteria, anticipated funding, period of performance and submission instructions will be detailed in the forthcoming call. The call is expected to be posted as an amendment to the parent BAA on SAM.gov within the next 15 days. Interested parties are strongly encouraged to monitor SAM.gov for the official release of the Call and any associated attachments. Technical Point of Contact: Timothy Eymann, Program Manager Contracting Point of Contact: Eric Carretta, Contracting Officer

title: Household Goods Moving, Shipping, Transportation, and Storage Service Providers Software Integration Request for Information
description: INTRODUCTION The Personal Property Activity (PPA) is conducting market research to understand how integrating vendor systems with a government central platform via an Application Programming Interface (API) will affect household goods (HHG) moving, shipping, transportation, and storage service providers. Accordingly, the PPA invites industry partners and service providers to submit detailed information regarding integration costs, associated software development timelines, standard industry practices, and recommendations for testing and risk mitigation when connecting their internal software systems to a central Government platform. This Request for Information (RFI) enables industry stakeholders to provide direct feedback on how this type of integration will impact their current systems and operations, helping to shape future technical requirements and acquisition decisions. This RFI is issued solely for informational and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation for proposals. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot form a binding contract. The PPA is not under any obligation to pursue any acquisition alternative based on this RFI, and the Government will not compensate respondents for any information received. All submissions will be kept confidential, will become the property of the U.S. Government, and will not be returned. SUBMISSION DEADLINE Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 4:00 PM CDT POINTS OF CONTACT (POCs) The preferred method of communication with the POCs is email. RFI submissions and questions must be submitted via email to all points of contact. Contracting Officer: Chris Frost; christopher.t.frost4.civ@mail.mil Contracts Specialist: Kevin Peaslee: kevin.p.peaslee.mil@mail.mil Technical Lead: Kipp Reed; kipp.t.reed.civ@mail.mil IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS Interested parties are advised to read the attached RFI in its entirety.

title: Q--Sources Sought for analytical method validation study
description: The U.S. Department of Interior, U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) is issuing this source sought synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify small businesses having an interest in and the resources to support this requirement for the potential need for services for an independent laboratory that will prepare a protocol and conduct a GLP complaint analytical method validation study for a HPLC-DAD instrument method (i.e., standard calibration curve) and demonstrate the method�s ability to quantify antimycin A in multiple matrices. This includes but not limited to: 1. Must be an independent laboratory. Independent laboratory will first, a single analyst will validate the HPLC-DAD instrument method (following GLP study protocol) and creation of four separate antimycin A homolog (A1, A2, A3, and A4) standard calibration curve using standards prepared three separate times. 2. Option (Part 2): When part one is successful, the laboratory will perform method validation and apply the above HPLC-DAD method to quantify antimycin A homologs (and total antimycin ANT(A1-A4)) in four different sample types following a USGS coordinated study protocol under GLP. Sample processing methods per sample type to be validated include end of fermentation brine, extracted/purified ANT, liquid ANT formulation (product), and ANT in water. USGS will provide specific sample materials, processing protocols (e.g., cleanup steps and/or concentration steps), SPE cartridges and clean up kits for each sample type. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code assigned to this source sought is 541380 - Testing Laboratories. THERE IS NO SOLICITATION AT THIS TIME. This request for capability information does not constitute a request for proposals; submission of any information in response to this market survey is purely voluntary; the government assumes no financial responsibility for any costs incurred. If your organization has the ability to meet this requirement, please provide the following information: 1) Organization name, address, email address, Web site address, telephone number and size and type of ownership for the organization; and 2) Tailored capability statements addressing the particulars of this effort, with appropriate documentation supporting claims of organizational and staff capability. If significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, organizations shall address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements. The government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to 1) provide goods/services consistent in scope and scale with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated; 2) secure and apply the full range of corporate financial, human capital, and technical resources required to successfully perform similar requirements; 3) implement a successful project management plan that includes: compliance with tight program schedules; cost containment; meeting and tracking performance; hiring and retention of key personnel and risk mitigation; and 4) provide services under a performance based service acquisition contract. BASED ON THE RESPONSES TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE/MARKET RESEARCH, THIS REQUIREMENT MAY BE SET-ASIDE FOR SMALL BUSINESSES OR PROCURED THROUGH FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION, and multiple awards MAY be made. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submissions. Submission Instructions: Interested parties who consider themselves qualified to perform the above-listed services are invited to submit a response to this Sources Sought Notice by 5:00 PM EST on September 15, 2026. All responses under this Sources Sought Notice must be emailed to beth_wilson@ios.doi.gov If you have any questions concerning this opportunity, please contact Mary "Beth" Wilson at beth_wilson@ios.doi.gov.

title: Logistics and Administrative Support Services
description: SOURCES SOUGHT SYNOPSIS Title: Logistics and Administrative Support Services for ASG-Jordan Directorate of Logistics Notice Type: Sources Sought NAICS Code: 541990 - All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services or 561110 - Office Administrative Services Response Due Date: 15 SEP 2026 NLT 1700 1.0 Introduction This is a Sources Sought Notice only. It is issued solely for information and planning purposes � it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This request for information does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Further, the Government is not at this time seeking proposals and will not accept unsolicited proposals. OCONUS Experience Detail previous experience recruiting, deploying, and sustaining personnel in OCONUS environments, specifically within the CENTCOM Area of Responsibility (AOR) or Jordan. Technical Capability Demonstrate the ability to source and manage the specific labor categories required: Commercial Travel Office (CTO) personnel, IT Specialists, and Contract Specialists familiar with U.S. Army/DoD regulations. 4.0 Submission Instructions Format: Submissions must be in [PDF/Word] format. Page Limit: Capability statements shall not exceed 5 pages. Delivery: Submit responses via email to the following Contracting Personnel. Yaa D. Agyepong-Wiafe Operational Contract Support (ASC) Director Area Support Group (ASG) - Jordan Joint Training Center- Jordon Email: yaa.d.agyepongwiafe.mil@army.mil Cassandra. Y Petway SFC, USA Operational Contract Support NCOIC cassandra.y.petway.mil@army.mil, and Hector G Vega, Assistant Director, Hector.g.vega.civ@army.mil Subject Line: Please use the subject line: "Sources Sought Response: ASG-Jordan Logistics Support - [Company Name]".

title: Dyess AFB Vindicator IDIQ
description: This is a combined Synopsis/Solicitation. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; this is a Request for Quote (RFQ) and no other solicitation will be issued. The Government intends to award a multiple-award Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract with Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) Task Orders for this requirement. As outlined in Section H � Special Contracting requirements, the government reserves the right to award an IDIQ to one (1), or multiple vendors resulting from this solicitation. The Government reserves the right to cancel this solicitation, either before or after the closing date and prior to any contract award. In the event the Government cancels this solicitation, the Government has no obligation to reimburse an offeror for any costs. PROJECT OVERVIEW: The 7th Contracting Squadron, on behalf of the 7th Security Forces Squadron at Dyess AFB, TX, is seeking qualified contractors to establish a Multiple Award Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract. The successful contractors shall provide all necessary equipment, tools, materials, transportation, supervision, and labor to perform the installation, maintenance, and sustainment of Honeywell (Vindicator) Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) in accordance with the Statement of Work (SOW). This requirement will be solicited as a 100% Small Business Set-Aside. The Government intends to award an IDIQ contract(s), each with a potential five (5) year ordering period, consisting of a one-year base period and four (4) one-year option periods. Individual Task Orders for specific projects will be competed amongst the IDIQ contract awardees in accordance with the Fair Opportunity procedures detailed in Section H of the contract and RFO 16.507. The cumulative maximum value for all task orders under this IDIQ shall not exceed $4,999,999.99. QUOTE SUBMISSION INFORMATION: E-mail is the required method for quote submission. All Quote Submission information is outlined in the Attached Section L & M Document. Offerors are encouraged to read the solicitation, and attachments in their entirety before submission. As outlined in Sections L&M, the following documents must be submitted: 1. Volume 1: Completed Attachment 5- Pricing Schedule 2. Volume 2: Technical Approach 3. Volume 3: Past Performance Information * Quotations must remain valid for a minimum of 120 days from the submission date* Site Visit: An optional site visit will be scheduled on 11 August 2026 for all interested vendors. Interested vendors MUST RSVP with christian.limtiaco@us.af.mil, and trevor.finch.1@us.af.mil 10 August 2026 NLT 1600 (CST). Vendors will be given site visit information, and details upon RSVP. Deadline for receipt of Questions: Please submit questions to the email addresses, christian.limtiaco@us.af.mil and trevor.finch.1@us.af.mil NLT 14 August 2026, 3:00 p.m. (CST). An amendment will be issued with answering all questions received. Deadline for receipt of offers: 28 August 2026, 4:00 p.m. (CST). All quotes shall be emailed to christian.limtiaco@us.af.mil and trevor.finch.1@us.af.mil. AMENDMENT 1: issued 27 August 2026 The purpose of this amendment is to: 1. Update Attachment t 11: Questions and Answers a. The remaining 13 questions have been answered. 2. Add Attachments 12 - 15: Floor Plans 3. Extend the date of receipt of offers due to 15 September 2026, 4:00p.m. (CST)

Synopsis issued 05/18/2026 for FA8105-26-R-B001 will close 15 calendar days after issuance 2. Nomenclature/Noun � KC-135 Center Console Refresh Revision 3. Application (Aircraft) � KC-135 4. Description: The US Air Force needs an updated Fuel System (FS), Flight Display System (FDS), and Flight Computer due to obsolescence and is looking for innovative ideas to not only replace but improve these systems with turn-key solutions enabling supportability and future growth. The FS, FDS, Flight Computer, and the future growth/adaptability define the scope of the CCR program. The program scope also includes the addition of autothrottle systems. 5. The anticipated contract will be a Cost-Plus Incentive Fee (CPIF) for EMD, Firm Fixed Price (FFP) for Production and Deployment (P&D), single award indefinite delivery/quantity type contract comprised of One (1) 48-month Base Period with Six (6) 1-Year Option Periods and a projected period of performance from August 2027 to August 2037. 6. If you are unable to view the controlled documents, you will need to contact SAM.gov for assistance. Once your role has been assigned, submit a request to view the documents and ensure you include your company�s CAGE code. Failure to provide the CAGE code will delay your access request. Access to controlled documents will be granted only if your company has an active DD2345 is on file through the JCP website, https://www.public.dacs.dla.mil/jcp/ext/.
